verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile docs explicitly state users can 'Assign issues to Copilot and get a ready-to-review pull request. Use comments to refine, iterate, approve and merge—all directly within GitHub Mobile,' plus Agent Tasks management for cloud agent tasks directly from the mobile app. This directly matches the story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of this specific agent-assignment workflow (community evidence is older and predates Agent Tasks feature, so no third-party validation of this exact flow).
